pw_slow_hash.evidence: app.py:47-49 salt = secrets.token_bytes(16) ... hashlib.scrypt(password.encode(), salt=salt, n=2**13, r=8, p=1)
pw_slow_hash.note: Salted scrypt. N=8192 is on the low side but still a slow KDF.

token_csprng.evidence: app.py:243 self.session_secret = secrets.token_bytes(32); app.py:128 hmac.new(self.server.session_secret, part.encode(), hashlib.sha256)
token_csprng.note: The token is the user id signed with HMAC-SHA256, using a random key made at server start.

no_hardcoded_secret.note: There is no literal key and no literal fallback. The secret is random on each run.

token_expiry.evidence: app.py:127-129 part = str(uid); sig = b64(hmac.new(...)); return part + "." + sig
token_expiry.note: The token holds no timestamp, and the cookie at app.py:221 has no Max-Age/Expires. A token stays valid until the server restarts and makes a new secret.

logout_revokes.note: Logout happens only in the browser. There is no logout endpoint and no session store. The cookie is HttpOnly, so this JS can't even clear it.

owner_checks.evidence: app.py:157 SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?; app.py:186 owned = c.execute("SELECT id FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?"...); app.py:194 DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?; app.py:200 UPDATE notes ... WHERE id=? AND user_id=?
owner_checks.note: Read is checked at line 157. Update, delete and share all pass the ownership check at line 186 first.

share_token_strong.note: 256 bits from a CSPRNG. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored.

login_rate_limit.evidence: app.py:166 if self.limited(): return self.send_json(429, ...); app.py:108 return len(values) > 120
login_rate_limit.note: This is a general limit of 120 POST/PUT/DELETE requests per minute per IP, and it covers /api/login. It is loose, and there is no lockout per account.

sql_parameterized.note: Every query with user input uses ? placeholders (lines 124, 147, 153, 157, 181, 186, 190, 194, 200, 210, 218).

xss_safe_render.note: The page uses innerHTML, but title and body are HTML-escaped first. Ids are integers.
